```{python}
#| include: false

# =============================================================================
# REPORT BUNDLE ACCESS (shared by the run-level sections moved from the Master Summary)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# REPORT_BUNDLE (modules/bridges/report_bundle.nf) gathers the module tables into
# report_bundle/<module>/ on every route; a module that did not run leaves its directory
# empty, so rb_read() returns None and the section explains the absence. run_info.tsv
# carries the route ("bulk", "vdj_only" or "full") and the run parameters the sections
# quote. Figures follow the Master Summary's look: its palette, left-aligned titles,
# hover text on every mark.
# =============================================================================

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from IPython.display import display, HTML

RB_DIR = 'report_bundle'
RB_PAL = ["#2c7fb8", "#d95f02", "#7570b3", "#1b9e77",
          "#e7298a", "#66a61e", "#e6ab02", "#a6761d"]
RB_TOP_GENES = 25
RB_TOP_CLUSTERS = 20


def rb_read(module, name):
    """A module table from the bundle, or None when the module did not run / wrote nothing."""
    path = os.path.join(RB_DIR, module, name)
    if not os.path.isfile(path) or os.path.getsize(path) == 0:
        return None
    try:
        df = pd.read_csv(path, sep=',' if name.endswith('.csv') else '\t', low_memory=False)
    except Exception:
        return None
    return df if len(df) else None


def rb_first(modules, name):
    """First module that has the table wins (CONSENSUS's copy is richer than CLUSTER_ROLLUP's)."""
    for m in modules:
        d = rb_read(m, name)
        if d is not None:
            return d
    return None


def rb_have(df):
    return df is not None and len(df) > 0


def rb_col(df, candidates):
    return next((c for c in candidates if c in df.columns), None)


def rb_note(text, kind='note'):
    print(f'\n::: {{.callout-{kind} appearance="simple"}}\n{text}\n:::\n')


def rb_heading(text, level=2):
    print(f"\n{'#' * level} {text}\n")


def rb_text(text):
    print(f"\n{text}\n")


def rb_table(df, max_height=440):
    """Whole table in a scrollable box, numbers to 3 significant digits."""
    if not rb_have(df):
        rb_note("No data available.")
        return
    # The Master Summary's table style (rt_table in _report_theme.qmd).
    print(f"\n```{{=html}}\n{rt_table(df, max_height=f'{max_height}px').data}\n```\n")


def _rb_layout(fig, title, height, **axes):
    fig.update_layout(title=dict(text=title, x=0, xanchor='left'), height=height,
                      margin=dict(t=60), **axes)
    fig.show(config=dict(displaylogo=False, modeBarButtonsToRemove=['select2d', 'lasso2d'],
                         toImageButtonOptions=dict(format='png', scale=2)))
    print("\n")


def _rb_groups(df):
    groups = list(dict.fromkeys(df['grp'].astype(str)))
    return [(g, df[df['grp'].astype(str) == g], RB_PAL[i % len(RB_PAL)]) for i, g in enumerate(groups)]


def rb_hbar(df, title, xlab, colour="#2c7fb8", height=440, tickformat=None):
    """Horizontal bar. df: cat, val, hover."""
    d = df.sort_values('val')
    fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(x=d['val'], y=d['cat'].astype(str), orientation='h', marker_color=colour,
                           text=d['hover'], hovertemplate='%{text}<extra></extra>', textposition='none'))
    _rb_layout(fig, title, height, xaxis=dict(title=xlab, tickformat=tickformat),
               yaxis=dict(title='', type='category'), margin_l=140)


def rb_sbar(df, title, xlab, height=470, tickformat='.0%'):
    """Stacked horizontal bar. df: cat, val, grp, hover."""
    fig = go.Figure()
    for g, d, c in _rb_groups(df):
        fig.add_trace(go.Bar(x=d['val'], y=d['cat'].astype(str), orientation='h', name=g, marker_color=c,
                             text=d['hover'], hovertemplate='%{text}<extra></extra>', textposition='none'))
    _rb_layout(fig, title, height, barmode='stack', xaxis=dict(title=xlab, tickformat=tickformat),
               yaxis=dict(title='', type='category'), legend=dict(orientation='h', y=-0.15), margin_l=140)


def rb_gbar(df, title, xlab, ylab, height=470):
    """Grouped vertical bar. df: cat, val, grp, hover."""
    fig = go.Figure()
    for g, d, c in _rb_groups(df):
        fig.add_trace(go.Bar(x=d['cat'].astype(str), y=d['val'], name=g, marker_color=c,
                             text=d['hover'], hovertemplate='%{text}<extra></extra>', textposition='none'))
    _rb_layout(fig, title, height, barmode='group', xaxis=dict(title=xlab, type='category'),
               yaxis=dict(title=ylab), legend=dict(orientation='h', y=-0.2))


def rb_boxby(df, title, ylab, height=470, logy=False, angle=0):
    """Box plot with every point (boxes only above 5,000 points, to keep the page light).
    df: grp, val, hover."""
    fig = go.Figure()
    for g, d, c in _rb_groups(df):
        if len(df) <= 5000:
            fig.add_trace(go.Box(x=[g] * len(d), y=d['val'], name=g, marker_color=c, boxpoints='all',
                                 jitter=0.4, pointpos=0, marker=dict(size=4, opacity=0.55),
                                 text=d['hover'], hoverinfo='text'))
        else:
            # Precomputed quartiles: the page carries five numbers per box, not every value.
            v = pd.to_numeric(d['val'], errors='coerce').dropna()
            q1, med, q3 = v.quantile([0.25, 0.5, 0.75])
            iqr = q3 - q1
            lo, hi = v[v >= q1 - 1.5 * iqr].min(), v[v <= q3 + 1.5 * iqr].max()
            fig.add_trace(go.Box(x=[g], q1=[q1], median=[med], q3=[q3], lowerfence=[lo],
                                 upperfence=[hi], name=f"{g} (n={len(v):,})", marker_color=c))
    _rb_layout(fig, title, height, showlegend=False, margin_b=110,
               xaxis=dict(title='', tickangle=angle),
               yaxis=dict(title=ylab, type='log' if logy else 'linear'))


def rb_scat(df, title, xlab, ylab, height=470, size=11, shapes=None):
    """Scatter. df: x, y, grp, hover."""
    fig = go.Figure()
    for g, d, c in _rb_groups(df):
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=d['x'], y=d['y'], mode='markers', name=g,
                                 marker=dict(size=size, opacity=0.85, color=c),
                                 text=d['hover'], hovertemplate='%{text}<extra></extra>'))
    _rb_layout(fig, title, height, xaxis=dict(title=xlab), yaxis=dict(title=ylab), shapes=shapes or [])


def rb_lplot(df, title, xlab, ylab, logx=True, logy=True, height=470):
    """Lines. df: x, y, grp, hover."""
    fig = go.Figure()
    for g, d, c in _rb_groups(df):
        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=d['x'], y=d['y'], mode='lines', name=g, line=dict(color=c),
                                 text=d['hover'], hovertemplate='%{text}<extra></extra>'))
    _rb_layout(fig, title, height, xaxis=dict(title=xlab, type='log' if logx else 'linear'),
               yaxis=dict(title=ylab, type='log' if logy else 'linear'))


# ---- Route and run parameters ------------------------------------------------
rb_info = {}
_ri = rb_read('.', 'run_info.tsv')
if _ri is not None and {'key', 'value'} <= set(_ri.columns):
    rb_info = dict(zip(_ri['key'].astype(str), _ri['value'].fillna('').astype(str)))
rb_route = rb_info.get('route', 'bulk')
rb_is_bulk = rb_route == 'bulk'
rb_is_sc = not rb_is_bulk
rb_has_gex = rb_route == 'full'

# Samples are labelled by their alias from the report samplesheet where it has one.
rb_alias = {}
try:
    _rb_ss = pd.read_csv(sample_table, sep=',', dtype=str).fillna('')
    if alias_col in _rb_ss.columns:
        rb_alias = {s: a for s, a in zip(_rb_ss['sample'], _rb_ss[alias_col]) if a}
except Exception:
    pass


def rb_label(samples):
    s = pd.Series(samples).astype(str)
    return s.map(rb_alias).fillna(s).values
```
